forecaster.name: Weather-driven carbon forecaster
forecaster.predicts: grid carbon intensity for each of the next 24 hours, per grid
forecaster.algorithm: gradient-boosted trees on the change from now (15 leaves, at least 40 samples per leaf, more wind can only lower it), then a blend with 'same as now' and 'same hour yesterday' learned per horizon band
forecaster.inputs: day-ahead weather forecasts (wind, sunshine, temperature, cloud; several points per grid), recent history, calendar
forecaster.weather_source: Open-Meteo, forecasts as issued one day earlier
forecaster.validation: boosting rounds and blend weights are chosen on the most recent 14 days, never on training data
forecaster.uncertainty: two more tree models predict the 10th and 90th percentile; the band is calibrated on the held-out days, then widened live by what the last week of checked forecasts says it needed
